title: C# Questions & Answers - Constructors in Class
sourceFile: Class Constructors - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# multiple choice questions focuses on constructors in class in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Number of constructors a class can define is?
questions.explanation: A constructor is a  simple method which has the same name as the class and hence used to create object of a class. C#  class can define any number of constructors. Every class contains a default constructor.

questions.question: The correct way of defining constructor of the given class as and when objects of classes are created is:
questions.code:
maths s1 = new maths();
   maths s2 = new maths(5, 5.4f);

questions.question: Correct way to define object of sample class in which C# code will work correctly is:
questions.explanation: Return types of parameters of object of class matches with defined constructor arguments types.

questions.question: Correct statement about constructors in C#.NET is?

options.text: Constructors have same name as name of the class

questions.question: Which among the following is the correct statement: Constructors are used to?

options.text: initialize the objects & construct the data members

questions.explanation: Once the object is declared means, the constructor is also declared by default.

questions.question: Can the method add() be overloaded in the following ways in C#?
questions.code:
public int add()  {    }
public float add(){    }
questions.explanation: C# provides the feature of method overloading which means methods with same name but different types and arguments.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct about constructors in C#.NET?

options.text: A constructor cannot be declared as private
A constructor can be a static constructor

questions.explanation: Static constructor is a constructor which can be called before any object of class is created or any static method is invoked. A static constructor is implicitly called by .net CLR.

questions.question: What is the return type of constructors?
questions.explanation: Constructors do not have any return type not even void included in it.
